Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.event

Interface ConnectionListener

public interface ConnectionListener
Receives the query and transaction events of a connection family.

Every method has an empty default body, so an implementation overrides only what it needs. A listener is registered with ConnectionBuilder.listener(ConnectionListener) or ConnectionEvents.addListener(ConnectionListener) and sees the events of the root connection and of every session, transaction and scope derived from it.

API Note:
While a listener method runs, statements the same thread runs on the connection fire no events and are not logged, so a listener may use the connection without recursing. A listener that throws does not stop the others: see each method for what reaches the caller.
Implementation Requirements:
An implementation must be safe to call from any thread that uses the connection, and should return quickly, because it runs on the caller's thread.

  • Method Details

    • queryExecuted

      default void queryExecuted(QueryExecuted event)
      Called after a statement ran successfully.

      A cursor fires this when it opens, so the event time covers opening only. A pretended statement fires it with a zero time.

      Parameters:
      event - the statement that ran, never null
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the listener fails; the caller then receives a ListenerFailedException, because the statement already succeeded

    • queryFailed

      default void queryFailed(QueryFailed event)
      Called when a statement failed, before the QueryException reaches the caller.
      Parameters:
      event - the statement that failed, never null
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the listener fails; the failure is added as a suppressed exception to the QueryException and never replaces it

    • transactionBeginning

      default void transactionBeginning(TransactionEvent event)
      Called after a transaction or savepoint was opened.
      Parameters:
      event - the level that began, never null
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the listener fails; the other listeners still run

    • transactionCommitting

      default void transactionCommitting(TransactionEvent event)
      Called before a transaction is committed or a savepoint is released.
      Parameters:
      event - the level about to finish, never null
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the listener fails; the failure propagates at once and the transaction rolls back

    • transactionCommitted

      default void transactionCommitted(TransactionEvent event)
      Called after a transaction was committed or a savepoint was released.
      Parameters:
      event - the level that finished, never null
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the listener fails; the transaction is already final, the other listeners still run and the first failure propagates

    • transactionRolledBack

      default void transactionRolledBack(TransactionEvent event)
      Called after a transaction or savepoint was rolled back.
      Parameters:
      event - the level that was rolled back, never null
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the listener fails; the transaction is already final, the other listeners still run and the first failure propagates
      API Note:
      On the root connection the outermost call happens before the thread leaves the transaction, so SQL the listener sends on the root connection is refused in strict mode; run such work from an afterRollback callback instead. A failed COMMIT whose outcome is unknown also ends here, so the transaction may have landed.
